help.label: About the data
help.title: About the data
help.body: Metrics cover all imported purchases. The period filter only affects the chart and monthly overview. The API sums TaxBaseAmount as expenses and TaxAmount as taxes; no net/gross interpretation is applied. The weekly value shows the growth in the cumulative total from receipts in the last seven days, not a week-over-week comparison. Missing values are shown as “—”.
